column3: “sacred” adds a description of the books.
“us” replaces them as the people driven away.
“You” replaces He; the clause describing the judges’ judging is omitted.
“Your sake, O Lord” changes the third-person reference into address.
Our desolations and the city are combined as the city’s desolation.
The BSB groups the seven and the sixty-two weeks together before the rebuilding statement; the Masoretic accentuation separates them.
“of the temple” supplies the wing’s location.
